layout: 3 object rows x 4 orthographic view columns in FRONT,TOP,RIGHT,LEFT order
prompt:
Create a 3-row by 4-column atlas of orthographic views of the three railway tile objects shown in the attached labeled source-and-current-views sheet. Use the actual SOURCE for each row as the identity, pattern, and material authority. Every atlas row is one specific object, in order: iron-tracks-rail-curve, iron-tracks-rail-t-junction, iron-tracks-rail-crossroads. Atlas columns are FRONT, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT. Each cell must show the same object from its named principal axis-aligned camera, upright world-Z, no perspective, no tilt, no isometric angle. Keep every subject isolated with generous transparent gutters. No labels, cell borders, shadows, or neighboring artifacts. Preserve original detailed pixel art and native stone ballast plus metal rails.

Row 1 iron-tracks-rail-curve:
FRONT: a low horizontal rail-edge elevation, full correct world-Z silhouette, stone ballast below the rail, not a view looking down at the tile.
TOP: a full-size square overhead plan of the quarter-circle curved track, exactly matching the curve direction and pebble ballast footprint in its SOURCE; the curved rail runs across the square plan and is not reduced to a tiny icon.
RIGHT and LEFT: low horizontal rail-edge profiles at the same height as FRONT/REAR, with the rail curving only in map-plane appearance; side views must not make an arched bridge or draw a tall curved stone wall.

Row 2 iron-tracks-rail-t-junction:
FRONT: retain the low horizontal rail-and-ballast elevation, one constant shared-Z.
TOP: full square footprint T-junction plan and surrounding square pebble ballast, preserve the source's T orientation and rail pattern; do not shrink the tile.
RIGHT and LEFT: low horizontal rail-edge profiles at shared world-Z, with ballast underneath. Do not show the entire overhead T rails upright.
Row 3 iron-tracks-rail-crossroads:
FRONT: low horizontal rail-and-ballast elevation, same shared-Z.
TOP: full square footprint crossroads plan with the source's four-way rail layout and square pebble ballast.
RIGHT and LEFT: low horizontal rail-edge profiles at shared world-Z, ballast underneath, not overhead upright rails.

The four output columns for every row must be FRONT, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT in that order. Make all three object patterns distinct and faithful to their own source. Orthographic flat views only; no accidental extra pieces.
